answer.says: Good morning, Shri Hegde. The air is thick this morning, but the light is sufficient. I trust you slept well in the second room; I hope the furniture does not trouble you while we await further orders.
answer.thought: The friction of the night has settled into a quiet morning, and the presence of this man who is not me, yet occupies my space, is the primary contradiction of the day. I must address him with the courtesy due to a colleague in the service of the state, even if our roles are inverted by a clerical error. The state is the actuality of the ethical idea, and even in its bureaucratic slip-ups, it maintains the form of order.
